name: Yamhill-Carlton Storehouse
description: A volunteer-run food pantry in Carlton providing food, personal care items, and blankets to Yamhill County residents in need, open Wednesdays and Fridays.

name: First Presbyterian Church of McMinnville Community Dinner
description: A free community dinner served every Saturday evening at First Presbyterian Church in McMinnville, open to anyone needing a meal or fellowship; the program has run since 2006 and serves about 5,000 meals a year.

name: Lydia's Closet
description: A community clothing closet in Amity affiliated with Amity Christian Church, providing clean clothing, bedding, linens, toiletries, toys and shoes to Yamhill County residents, including emergency support after local house fires.
registrationNote: Ministry of Amity Christian Church; no separate IRS registration

name: The Salvation Army - McMinnville Corps
description: The local Salvation Army corps (also known as the Yamhill County Service and Ministry Center), providing a food pantry, clothing donations, and financial assistance to Yamhill County residents facing poverty, hunger and homelessness.
registrationNote: Local corps of The Salvation Army (national organization); likely registered under the national/territorial EIN, not a standalone Yamhill County filing

name: Promise Church Food Pantry
description: A Sunday food pantry run by Promise Church in Dundee, providing income-based food boxes to Yamhill County families in need.

name: Baker Creek Community Church Food Box Program
description: A weekly food box and bread distribution program run by Baker Creek Community Church in McMinnville for Yamhill County residents, limited to one box per family per month.

name: Northwest Christian Church Community Kitchen
description: A free hot meal program at Northwest Christian Church's Newberg campus, serving prepared meals every Thursday evening to anyone in the community; running since 2005 and has served over 50,000 meals.
registrationNote: Program of Northwest Christian Church (already IRS-registered); the meal program itself is not separately registered

name: Cove Orchard Food Pantry
description: A by-appointment food box pantry run by the Community of Christ congregation in Yamhill (Cove Orchard area), serving Yamhill County residents.
